A Moral Voyage: Mighty Theme

Published on Oct 20, 2015
  • Highlights
  • Thesis

From Honors Student Blog:

“To produce a mighty book, you must choose a mighty theme.” – Herman Melville, Moby Dick

No matter when you start your CHC career, one goal looms in the distance: the senior thesis. It’s not a requirement per se, but it’s highly encouraged that students write one as conclusion to the CHC experience, and it’s been one of my goals since coming to UMass. But as I’m starting to learn in the process, you don’t really know how to write a thesis until you dive right in.
